interactive.label: Load VV/VH file…
interactive.tooltip: Load a paired parallel/perpendicular decay (.dat or .txt, VV followed by VH). Dropping a file on the window does the same.

interactive.label: Save outputs…
interactive.tooltip: Save the shifted VV/VH decays (<name>_shifted.dat), the anisotropy trace (<name>_anisotropy.txt: channel, r(t), r(t) minus r-infinity) and the r-infinity metadata (<name>_rinf.csv).

interactive.label: Batch files…
interactive.tooltip: Open the batch window: queue many VV/VH files and compute r-infinity for each with the current settings.

interactive.label: loaded_file
interactive.tooltip: The VV/VH file that is loaded.

interactive.label: g_factor
interactive.tooltip: Detector sensitivity correction applied to VH (0 to 10).

interactive.label: Apply backgrounds
interactive.tooltip: Subtract constant VV and VH backgrounds before calculation.

interactive.label: bg_vv
interactive.tooltip: Constant background to subtract from VV.

interactive.label: bg_vh
interactive.tooltip: Constant background to subtract from VH.

interactive.label: Flip VV↔VH
interactive.tooltip: Swap channels when the source file has reversed polarization (data swapped in VV/VH).

interactive.label: shift
interactive.tooltip: Shift VH by a fractional channel using interpolation (-150 to 150).

interactive.label: region_start
interactive.tooltip: First channel in the r-infinity averaging region.

interactive.label: region_end
interactive.tooltip: Last boundary of the r-infinity averaging region.

interactive.label: r_infty_text
interactive.tooltip: r-infinity: the mean of r(t) over the region, five decimals; N/A when there is no valid point in it.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: A step-by-step walk through the tool.
